name: AI.MD Notes
description: Markdown notes connection type: create an AI.MD Notes connection to open the notebook workbench. Notes are persisted into the configured storage directory as real .md files and can be browsed and edited via the mdnotes:// virtual filesystem. Built-in AI assistant supports note analysis, polishing, continuation, and Q&A with OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, or Ollama models.

contributions.label: AI.MD Notes
contributions.description: Create an AI.MD Notes connection to open a standalone Markdown notebook workbench.

fields.label: Connection name
fields.description: Name shown in the connection list.

fields.label: Notes storage directory
fields.description: Required. The sidecar writes each note as a real .md file and each folder as a subfolder under this directory; the structure index is stored in .mdnotes/meta.json. Click the folder button to pick a local directory, or type an absolute path.

fields.label: Enable AI features
fields.description: When enabled, an AI assistant panel appears on the right of the workbench for note analysis, polishing, continuation, and Q&A. When disabled, subsequent AI settings are hidden and no external requests are made. Initial configuration can be edited directly inside the workbench AI panel.

fields.label: AI provider
fields.description: Select API protocol. Most domestic models and self-hosted gateways are OpenAI-compatible.

fields.label: API base URL
fields.description: Service root URL without /chat/completions. Ollama defaults locally to http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.

fields.label: Model name
fields.description: Model identifier from provider docs, e.g. deepseek-chat, gpt-4o-mini, qwen2.5:7b.

fields.label: API key
fields.description: Stored securely in DBX secret storage and sent only to the plugin backend; never written to note files, logs, or cache. Leave empty to keep existing key. Local Ollama models can leave this blank.

fields.label: Custom system prompt (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank to use the built-in system prompt. Any text entered here replaces the default persona.

fields.label: Request timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Increase for slower models. Allowed range: 5–300.

fields.label: Max input characters per request
fields.description: Text exceeding this limit is truncated with a UI notice to stay within context windows. Allowed range: 500–200000.

actions.label: Test AI connection
actions.description: Sends a minimal request using the current endpoint, key, and model to confirm connectivity before saving.

contributions.label: AI.MD Notes
contributions.description: Expose notes as .md files in the DBX file manager (mdnotes://).
